headline: Travelsoft says all but one customer platform are back and no fraudulent bookings were found.
summary: Added s003, a new L'Echo touristique article (Nov 22; same Travelsoft-affiliated outlet as s001, so not an independent check). c004 now says all customer platforms but one were working by Sunday evening, with the last due Monday, and the B2B site was back; it stays Reported (one outlet). c006 adds that the company asked suppliers to change logins and changed its own passwords; stays Reported, theft not confirmed by the company. c008 adds the company's statement that it found no fraudulent bookings; stays Not established. c009 notes an investigation is under way; stays Not established. New timeline row t005. No Travelsoft notice on its own site, no CNIL or ANSSI statement, no ransom claim in the press and no French national or security press found.
